tools.name: get_live_spot_prices
tools.description: Get live Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), Platinum (XPT), and Palladium (XPD) spot prices in USD per troy ounce, plus the real-time Gold-to-Silver Ratio (GSR).

tools.name: search_bullion_catalog
tools.description: Search and filter OunceScout's canonical gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion catalog (coins, bars, rounds) with lowest verified dealer prices and multi-dealer offer counts.

tools.name: compare_product_dealers
tools.description: Get full side-by-side dealer price quotes, shipping policies, payment basis, and in-stock status for a specific bullion product by slug or product ID.

tools.name: calculate_budget_stack
tools.description: Run the OunceScout Smart Budget Stack Calculator to find the optimal physical Gold & Silver bullion stack for a target USD budget at today's lowest live dealer prices.

tools.name: list_verified_dealers
tools.description: List OunceScout's verified US bullion dealers, directory statuses, and Featured Dealer (Agate Precious Metals).

tools.name: get_dealer_profile
tools.description: Get a verified bullion dealer's public profile, stored shipping-policy summary, current catalog size, and newest/oldest current-offer timestamps.

tools.name: list_dealer_offers
tools.description: List a dealer's current public offers, stalest first by default, with prices, stock and verification status, observation timestamps, and computed age. Use this as a self-service stale-offer audit.

tools.name: get_dealer_price_position
tools.description: For one product, compare a dealer's delivered price with every other dealer's delivered price, return its rank and gap to the lowest offer, and compare its premium over spot with the field median.

tools.name: get_premium_index
tools.description: Aggregate premium-over-spot and delivered-price statistics across fresh (<=96h) verified public offers, optionally filtered by metal and product format.

tools.name: get_market_freshness_index
tools.description: Get live real-time price freshness metrics across OunceScout catalog: counts of verified listings under 4 hours, stale items, continuous verification cycle metrics, and IndexNow broadcast status.
